summary: RE-TEST of FR/FA full-app translation after the iteration_104 fixes (frontend only, public preview URL). Verified language switch via [data-testid=lang-select] to fr/fa, all 5 bottom-nav tabs, Learn tab (previous crash), Home, Your Lab PaywallGate grid, Recipes tab + Novita/news, Encyclopedia, Ricette Custodite (FA list + back label), font/RTL, plus IT/DE regression. RESULT: the 3 blocking items are FIXED (Learn no longer crashes, Home body is FR/FA, PaywallGate feature grid is FR/FA, FA Vazirmatn font + dir=rtl OK, FA custodite list and back label are Persian). REMAINING: Encyclopedia bodies still Italian in FR+FA (works in DE), 4 static UI strings still EN/IT on Home and Learn, some FA recipe titles are identity-mapped, and recipe method filter chips untranslated. No JS page errors; only the 4x pre-existing 401s.

ui_bugs.component: sections/GuidaMetodi.jsx:57 (Encyclopedia 'Encyclopédie de mon pain' / 'دانشنامهٔ نان من')
ui_bugs.issue: Accordion titles AND bodies are still 100% ITALIAN in FR and FA (DE shows German, so it is FR/FA-specific). Verified strings: 'Poolish' -> 'Il poolish è un prefermento LIQUIDO: parti uguali di farina e acqua (idratazione 100%)...', 'Lievito Madre — pane vs panettone', 'Roggen Sauerteig (pasta acida di segale)', 'Backmittel (Miglioratore naturale)', 'Autolisi', 'Incordatura', 'Prova del velo', 'Puntata (lievitazione in massa)', 'Fermolievitazione (frigo)', 'Maturazione vs Lievitazione' (33 entries). Root cause: METODI_SECTIONS objects only have it/de and the consumer does `const c = s[lang] || s.it`. Identical pattern in sections/Enciclopedia.jsx:145-146 (METODI_SECTIONS + ENC_ENTRIES).

Shows ENGLISH 'Your digital companion 🇮🇹 🇩🇪 🇬🇧 🇪🇸' in both FR and FA. mkTri is used but triTranslations.json has NO key 'Il tuo compagno digitale', so it falls back to EN. Also the hardcoded flag list still shows only IT/DE/GB/ES (missing 🇫🇷 🇮🇷).

Label renders 'FLAVOUR OF THE DAY' in FR and in FA (should be 'Saveur du Jour' / Persian). Missing map key 'Il Sapore del Giorno' in triTranslations.json (the flavour name+description below it ARE correctly translated).

Learn tab no longer crashes, but ITALIAN leaks in FR and FA: bubbles 'Impara con calma: qui trovi la ricetta del giorno, i video e il tuo percorso passo-passo.' and 'Fai il Quiz del Fornaio e segna i progressi: ti accompagno io, senza fretta.' (objects only it/de/en/es, `b[lang] || b.it`); label 'RICETTA DEL GIORNO' (Beginners.jsx:448 raw ternary de/es/en/else-it) and the daily-recipe card body 'Panini al latte / Ingredienti: 500 g farina · 250 g latte ... / Impasta tutto fino a incordare, lievita 2 h...' (DAILY_RECIPES has no fr/fa and no map keys).

Some FA recipe titles are still Italian because the map holds identity values: 'Pane di Matera IGP' -> {fr:'Pane di Matera IGP', fa:'Pane di Matera IGP'}, same for 'Focaccia Barese', 'Taralli Pugliesi', 'Friselle Pugliesi', 'Puccia Salentina'. Effect: FA Recipes hero shows 'Pane di Matera IGP' and FA custodite list shows 'Pane di Matera IGP', 'Focaccia Barese', 'نان Altamura DOP' (half-translated), while FR list correctly shows 'Pain de Matera'/'Focaccia de Bari' from other keys -> inconsistent.

Untranslated in FR and FA: 'Poolish', 'Biga', 'Lievito Madre', 'LM di Segale', 'LiCoLi', 'Farina Cotta', 'Quark', 'Indiretto', 'Diretto' ('Tutte'->'Toutes'/'همه' works). Missing map keys 'Indiretto', 'Diretto' (jargon like Poolish/Biga may be intentional, but Indiretto/Diretto are plain Italian).

PRE-EXISTING (not FR/FA specific): the glossary term definitions are raw Italian for every language, incl. DE/EN ('Autolisi: Riposo iniziale di farina e acqua...', 'Biga: Prefermento solido (idratazione ~45%)...'). FR shows the full Italian list. Only the chrome (back/search/title) uses mkTri.

issues: FIXED: Persian glyphs now render correctly shaped/joined; computed fontFamily = 'Vazirmatn, Manrope, sans-serif'; document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl' and layout mirrors correctly (header, cards, bottom nav).
Only residual mixed-language element is the avatar subtitle (English) + 'FLAVOUR OF THE DAY' badge; rest of the page reads natively.

Add missing map keys to i18n/triTranslations.json: 'Il tuo compagno digitale', 'Il Sapore del Giorno', 'Indiretto', 'Diretto', the two AvatarBubbles Learn strings, 'Ricetta del giorno' and the 'Panini al latte' daily-recipe strings.

Replace real FR/FA values for the identity-mapped keys 'Pane di Matera IGP', 'Focaccia Barese', 'Taralli Pugliesi', 'Friselle Pugliesi', 'Puccia Salentina' (at least transliterate for FA to match what FR already does).
Convert sections/Beginners.jsx:448 raw ternary to mkTri and route DAILY_RECIPES / AvatarBubbles arrays through deepT.
Add 🇫🇷 🇮🇷 to the flag list in Home.jsx:146 (or drop the hardcoded flags).
Optional/pre-existing: localize sections/Glossario.jsx TERMS (currently Italian even in DE/EN).
critical_code_review_comments: 19 remaining call sites use the anti-pattern `DATA[lang] || DATA.it` (Beginners.jsx:232/352/354, Enciclopedia.jsx:145-146, GuidaMetodi.jsx:57, IntroGuide.jsx:22, LegalPage.jsx:48, SupplierOrder.jsx:21, RecipeList.jsx:960/977, TalkingAvatar.jsx:48, SimulatoreForno.jsx:47, CalcolatoreMetodo.jsx:72, ProfilePanel.jsx:142-143, Home.jsx:216/220/466). Any language without a dedicated key silently falls back to Italian - wrap with deepT(DATA.it, triXX) like data/content.js does.
There are still ~149 raw `lang === "de" ? ... :` ternaries across sections/components; add an ESLint rule banning language comparisons outside src/i18n to stop this class of regression.
triTranslations.json contains identity entries (fr/fa == it) which are indistinguishable from real translations; add a build check that fails on identity pairs so gaps are visible.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% - all 5 tabs render in FR and FA with no crash/console errors; residual untranslated: Encyclopedia bodies (HIGH), 4 static strings, some FA recipe titles, filter chips

Only console noise = 4x/9x 401 on unauthenticated API calls (pre-existing).
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_104 fixes (content.fr/content.fa built with deepT, PaywallGate row-level mkTri, Home SCENE_PHRASES, Vazirmatn font) all work. The residual gaps have two causes: (1) data objects that live OUTSIDE data/content.js and are selected with `DATA[lang] || DATA.it` (GuidaMetodi METODI_SECTIONS, AvatarBubbles, Beginners DAILY_RECIPES) were never passed through deepT, so fr/fa fall back to Italian; (2) mkTri correctly delegates to the FR/FA map but the map is missing (or identity-holds) a handful of Italian source keys, so those strings fall through to English or stay Italian.
